verdict.rationale: Bitbucket Pipelines configs live in the same git repo, so pull-request review (docs-7, docs-11) and change-management enforcement (docs-6) apply to pipeline/automation changes, and AI-powered pipeline workflows are documented (docs-4, docs-8, docs-10). However, no evidence explicitly confirms automation-specific versioning history, dedicated review flows for automation scripts, or a rollback mechanism for automations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automation version history/diffing, dedicated review workflow for automation changes, and an explicit rollback/undo feature for pipeline or Rovo-triggered automations.
